title: As Language Models Scale, Low-order Linear Depth Dynamics Emerge

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the change in toxicity concept scores under layerwise additive activation steering (concept injection) to evaluate the predictive accuracy of linear surrogates, using the Civil Comments Toxicity dataset.
Evaluating the model's sensitivity and the change in hate speech concept scores under multi-layer activation interventions using the TweetEval-Hate dataset.
